sandbachFocus: Sandbach United were not in league action this weekend, instead competing in the FA Vase preliminary round where they suffered a narrow defeat to Ashby Ivanhoe. The Bach put in effort but couldn't find the breakthrough, with their Vase campaign coming to an end in disappointing fashion after a better second-half display proved insufficient to change the scoreline.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals maintained their position at the top with a 1-0 away victory at Dawley Town, courtesy of Liam Kirton's 66th-minute goal, extending their excellent start despite Dawley's numerical disadvantage for most of the match following a red card. AFC Bridgnorth remain unbeaten but saw their record tested against Crewe, ultimately prevailing 4-1 in an entertaining encounter at Crown Meadow. Shawbury United secured a 3-2 victory over Widnes Town in a thrilling contest, bouncing back with multiple goals to secure three points. Bilston Town delivered an impressive 3-0 away win at Brereton Social, demonstrating their defensive solidity and attacking prowess. Both Stafford Town and Market Drayton Town exited the FA Vase in disappointing fashion, losing to Abbey Hulton United and Studley respectively, with the latter enduring a particularly frustrating afternoon featuring multiple bookings and a red card. Eccleshall and Foley Meir both progressed in cup competition, though the focus remains on league form where Eccleshall's midweek victory over Wolverhampton Casuals showed their title credentials remain viable.
